verdict.rationale: Fetching data in server-rendered components and passing it to client components is a fair question for a UI framework, so the axis applies. The pack has no Vue documentation of async server components, server-side data fetching, or a server-to-client data handoff. The one SSR mention is a user relying on Nuxt.js, a separate framework, which is a user-side choice and earns no credit here.
